inputs.task_description:
请您建立一个基于TRNSYS的两层办公建筑热工性能仿真模型。我们需要分析这栋位于德国斯图加特地区的办公楼在典型气象条件下的室内热环境和能耗表现。

仿真基本设置：仿真时长为7天（168小时），仿真步长1小时，积分容差和收敛容差均为0.001。

天气数据：天气文件已为您准备好，位于"d:\TRNSYS18_03\Weather\Meteonorm\Europe\DE-Stuttgart-107370.tm2"。需要处理7个不同朝向表面的太阳辐射数据，包括水平面、南向25度倾斜面、南向垂直面、西向垂直面、北向25度倾斜面、北向垂直面和东向垂直面。地面反射率无雪时取0.2，有雪覆盖时取0.7，采用倾斜表面辐射计算模式3。

建筑模型：建筑模型配置文件已为您准备好，位于"D:\TRNSYS18_03\Examples\3D_Building\2_Step_Import_Studio\Building_step2.b18"。该建筑为两层结构，包含一层办公区（first_floor）和二层办公区（second_floor）两个热区。多区域建筑模型的操作温度权重因子设为0.50。

地面温度边界条件：采用简化地面温度模型计算地下土壤温度作为建筑底部边界条件。土壤热导率8.72 W/(m·K)，土壤密度3200 kg/m³，土壤比热0.84 kJ/(kg·K)。年平均地表温度9.0°C，年温度振幅9.0°C，最低温度出现在第11个月。计算深度为1米处的土壤温度。

遮阳控制策略：当外墙面接收的太阳辐射强度超过140 W/m²（504 kJ/(h·m²)）时关闭遮阳装置，低于120 W/m²（432 kJ/(h·m²)）时打开遮阳装置。内部遮阳和外部遮阳的最大不透明度均为70%。建筑边界温度设定为20°C。

输出要求：
1. 7个朝向表面的总辐射强度和直射辐射强度曲线（单位：W/m²）
2. 室外环境温度、一层和二层办公区的室内空气温度和操作温度曲线
3. 地下1米深度处的土壤温度变化曲线
4. 一层和二层办公区的供热负荷和供冷负荷曲线（单位：W/m²）
5. 一层和二层办公区的设备电力负荷和照明电力负荷曲线（单位：W/m²）

本模型旨在评估建筑在典型气象条件下的热工性能表现，为建筑节能设计提供参考依据。

component_plan.description: Meteonorm TM2 weather data reader for Stuttgart. Reads ambient temperature, humidity, solar radiation, wind speed, and other meteorological data. Configured with 7 tilted surfaces: horizontal, south-25°-tilted, south-vertical, west-vertical, north-25°-tilted, north-vertical, and east-vertical. Tilted surface radiation mode 3, ground reflectance 0.2 (no snow) and 0.7 (snow cover).

Multi-zone building model with two thermal zones (first_floor office and second_floor office). Loads the pre-configured building file (Building_step2.b18) with 3D geometry, construction materials, internal gains, and infiltration. Operative temperature weight factor set to 0.50. Building boundary temperature set to 20°C.

Simplified ground temperature model calculating soil temperature at 1-meter depth as the building bottom boundary condition. Soil thermal conductivity 8.72 W/(m·K), density 3200 kg/m³, specific heat 0.84 kJ/(kg·K). Mean annual surface temperature 9.0°C, amplitude 9.0°C, minimum temperature in month 11.

Shading control logic: closes shading devices when incident solar radiation on external wall exceeds 140 W/m² (504 kJ/(h·m²)), opens when below 120 W/m² (432 kJ/(h·m²)). Both internal and external shading maximum opacity set to 70%.
Equation block for implementing shading control logic with hysteresis (close above 140 W/m², open below 120 W/m²) and for unit conversions between kJ/(h·m²) and W/m² if needed.

Online plotters for visualizing: (1) total and beam radiation on 7 surfaces, (2) ambient temperature plus first_floor and second_floor indoor air and operative temperatures, (3) ground temperature at 1m depth, (4) heating and cooling loads for both floors, (5) equipment and lighting electrical loads for both floors.
Printer/output component for saving all simulation results to a file for further analysis and reporting.

本模型旨在评估建筑在典型气象条件下的热工性能表现，为建筑节能设计提供参考依据。
